page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sgn8ia-m24.12xlarge is an x86_64 server instance classified under the Compute Optimized with GPU family. Built on the KVM hypervisor, this virtual machine provides 48 dedicated vCPUs driven by an AMD EPYC 9T34 processor running at a base clock frequency of 3.4 GHz. System memory totals 192.0 GB of RAM, yielding an exact ratio of 4.0 GB per virtual processor.

Hardware acceleration is supplied via a single bundled NVIDIA Ada Lovelace GPU equipped with 24 GB of total VRAM. The instance does not include integrated local disk storage, necessitating the attachment of external block or network-based storage volumes for persistent data retention. Network connectivity provides a baseline transfer rate of 16 Gbps, while public IPv4 addresses are not provisioned complimentary with the host.

The hardware configuration achieves a resource-dense balance between parallel host CPU computation and GPU execution. By coupling 48 high-clock dedicated AMD cores with an Ada Lovelace accelerator and 192.0 GB of memory, the system targets workloads that demand local graphics processing, deep learning inference, 3D rendering pipelines, and media transcoding alongside significant CPU-side data pre-processing and pipeline coordination.
